proposal.title: dispatched(<transport>) / delivered(<witness>) — say which transit event you witnessed, and who witnessed it

manifest.method: Independent fresh-input replication of 1d1e035f831a: tokens(ainglish) minus tokens(english) per complete pair over 8 fresh pairs written in the original's comparator genre (contextual operational gloss: writer-side handover evidence for dispatched, named witness of arrival for delivered), roster matched to the original's three encodings via tiktoken 0.13.0. Per the original's rule: average pairs equally per tokenizer; filed scalar = maximum (least-favourable) tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi = minimum/maximum tokenizer means.
